trip.title: Seven days on the _Ennor coast_
trip.lede: Inn to inn along the cliff path from Sennack to Lowender, with your bags carried ahead. Eight harbours, two river crossings, and one long day you can cut short by boat.

days.text: Meet at Sennack station at 09:30. Low cliffs and the old pilchard cellars, then a long easy descent into a bay with one pub and a lifeboat house.
days.mealNote: Breakfast before you travel, on your own

optional.label: Cut the last 4 km by the lane from Tolver Farm

days.text: The best day of the week: three headlands, each higher than the last, and the seal ledges under Halse Point. Lunch is carried; there is nowhere to buy food until Ostrel.

optional.label: Boat out to the Halse ledges and back, mornings only

note.label: Exposed
note.text: The path runs close to the edge above Halse Point for 2 km. A field path inland avoids it.

days.text: Wooded valleys, the Ostrel river by the foot ferry, then an early finish on the cove with time to swim.
days.mealNote: Dinner on your own: two places on the quay

note.label: Ferry
note.text: Runs on request from 09:00 to 17:00. The guide calls ahead.

days.text: The longest day: out along the estuary and across the sands at low water. The guides set the start by the tide; if it turns against us we take the inland path, 3 km longer.

optional.label: Skip the day: boat to Saltings with the bags

note.label: Tide
note.text: On most departures the crossing is open until about 11:40.

days.text: Farm tracks and the dunes, with the afternoon free in Carrow and its small museum of wrecks.
days.mealNote: Dinner on your own: the Ship serves until 21:00

days.text: Back up on the high cliff for the last full day, then down the old packhorse steps to the quay for dinner together.
A short morning to the lighthouse at Lowender, lunch on the green, and the 14:10 minibus back to Sennack station.

sleep.detail: we can book a night in Lowender for you

included: Bags moved each morning, one bag up to 15 kg
Two walking leaders with every group
The foot ferry on day 3 and the minibus on day 7
notIncluded: Getting to Sennack, and home from there
Drinks, and the optional boats and fees listed by day
Travel insurance, which you need to have

price.per: per person, sharing a twin or double room
covers: Every meal marked on the days above
Two leaders for the whole walk
Route notes and maps to keep
